scenario.name: High Noise
scenario.description: The lowest-contrast real window available (INDIA-GAURI: mean cell sits -0.77 dB from its own decision threshold, 95th percentile only 0.5 dB above it) seen through a receiver at 1.5 dB of dwell noise instead of the usual 0.4. Almost everything sits near the boundary, so confident detection and honest uncertainty pull apart.
